correctness.rationale: Fixed-pair intersection process is exactly a killed 2x2 nonnegative matrix. Its characteristic polynomial and positive eigenvector yield finite two-sided survival bounds. Union bound/geometric series gives finite expectation bound and δ=2(r-1)/n²(1+O_r(1/n)) yields sharp upper constant. Exact rational enumeration checks all transitions through n=10 and seven rounds, without claiming infinite computational proof.
